```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
# Load Required Libraries
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)

```

### Johannes
```{r}

# Load and Process Yield Curve Data
files <- list.files("yield", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.csv$")
yield_curve <- files %>%
  map_df(read_csv)
yield_curve$Date <- as.Date(yield_curve$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")
yield_curve <- yield_curve %>% 
  mutate(spread = `10 Yr` - `3 Mo`)

# Aggregate Yield Data by Month for Twitter analysis
yield_monthly <- yield_curve %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(spread = mean(spread, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(date = month)

# Load Twitter Economic Uncertainty Data
twitter <- read_csv("Twitter_Economic_Uncertainty.csv")
twitter$date <- as.Date(twitter$date)
twitter_monthly <- twitter %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(avg_teu = mean(`TEU-WGT`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(date = month)

# Merge Yield and Uncertainty Data
yield_twitter <- inner_join(twitter_monthly, yield_monthly, by = "date")

# Plot: Twitter Uncertainty vs Yield Spread
ggplot(yield_twitter, aes(x = spread, y = avg_teu)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#2C7BB6") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#D7191C", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "10-Year - 3-Month Yield Spread",
    y = "Twitter Economic Uncertainty Index",
    title = "Bond Yield Spread and Economic Uncertainty (2011-2023)",
    subtitle = "Monthly data showing relationship between yield curve and uncertainty"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

twitter_model <- lm(avg_teu ~ spread, data = yield_twitter)
summary(twitter_model)


```
### Halfdan
```{r}
# Aggregate Yield Data by Year for music analysis
yield_yearly <- yield_curve %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Date)) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(spread = mean(spread, na.rm = TRUE))

# Load Billboard Hot 100 Data
df_bb <- read.csv("Hot100.csv")

# Join Billboard data with yearly yield data
df_analysis <- inner_join(df_bb, yield_yearly, by = "Year") %>%
  filter(Year < 2020)

# Mixed model: Danceability predicted by spread with random effect for year
mixed_model <- lm(Danceability ~ spread, data = df_analysis)
summary(mixed_model)

# For plotting, calculate yearly averages
df_year <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_dance = mean(Danceability, na.rm = TRUE),
    spread = mean(spread, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Plot: Danceability vs Yield Spread
ggplot(df_year, aes(x = spread, y = avg_dance)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = "#2C7BB6") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", linewidth = 1.2, color = "#D7191C", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Danceability and Yield Curve Spread",
    subtitle = "Does economic stress correlate with music preferences?",
    x = "Yield Curve Spread (pp)",
    y = "Average Danceability (0-1 scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
